newsitem.title: CHINA: China urges setting up fibre optic sector groups.
newsitem.headline: China urges setting up fibre optic sector groups.

text.p: China's fibre optics companies should set up large enterprise groups to overcome foreign dominance in the sector, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.

The low technological level of the optical cable industry had made it unable to meet demand in the domestic market, leaving the gap to be filled by foreign companies, Xinhua quoted specialists from the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications as saying.
The industry had nearly 200 optical cable plants throughout China, making large-scale production impossible, the specialists said.
The specialists also recommended that Beijing issue preferential policies for the sector and increase capital to the industry's large state-owned firms, Xinhua said without giving further details.
China has formed industry groups in many sectors to try to consolidate production, cut down waste and make its companies more competitive.
